task_instance: Build a small ASP.NET Core Minimal API (a Todo API) that follows the skill's guidance: endpoints grouped with MapGroup, explicit request/response DTOs as records with validation attributes and [Description] annotations, TypedResults/Results<T1,T2> for strongly-typed multi-response endpoints, and built-in .NET OpenAPI document generation (AddOpenApi/MapOpenApi) with WithName/WithSummary/WithDescription operation metadata. Build the project, run it, exercise GET/POST endpoints including a validation-failure path, and fetch and inspect the generated /openapi/v1.json document.
tools_used: dotnet CLI (dotnet new, dotnet add package, dotnet build, dotnet run)
evidence: Created TodoApi/Program.cs (.NET 10 SDK, targets net10.0) using builder.Services.AddOpenApi() and app.MapOpenApi(); a MapGroup("/todos") with tags; GET / (TypedResults.Ok), GET /{id} returning Results<Ok<TodoItem>, NotFound>, and POST / returning Results<Created<TodoItem>, ValidationProblem> with manual [Required]/[MaxLength] validation; record DTOs TodoItem and CreateTodoRequest with [Description] on properties; WithName/WithSummary/WithDescription on each endpoint. `dotnet add package Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi` succeeded (network reachable to api.nuget.org). `dotnet build` succeeded with 0 warnings/0 errors. Ran the app (`dotnet run`, listening on http://localhost:5092) and verified via curl: GET /todos returned the seeded list (200), GET /todos/1 returned the item (200), GET /todos/99 returned 404, POST /todos with a valid title returned 201 with the created todo (id 3), POST /todos with an empty title returned 400 with a ProblemDetails-style validation error body ({"errors":{"Title":["The Title field is required."]}}). Fetched http://localhost:5092/openapi/v1.json (200) and confirmed it contains paths for /todos and /todos/{id} with correct operationIds (GetTodos, GetTodoById, CreateTodo), summaries, descriptions, tags (Todos), and component schemas for TodoItem/CreateTodoRequest/HttpValidationProblemDetails.
